race.comment: The class runner is AIR ASSAULT (1) who opened this prep with three strong performances at stakes level before losing his way a bit at the last couple, most recently in the Group 3 Coongy over 2000m at Caulfield. Has raced here four times over 1800m for four wins. Prolific stakes winner who is beautifully placed to get the job done. Veteran BAMYAN BUDDHA (4) added the Gawler Cup to the trophy cabinet last time out when he took out the 1500m feature by a length. Yet to prove himself at this distance but is racing too well to dismiss. SIR KINGSFORD (2) led and just failed to hang on over a mile in the Murray Bridge Cup two back. Unsuited dropping back to 1500m last time but can bounce back with this step up in distance. WILLIAMSBURG (5) has been proven many times at this level - can improve on a modest effort over 2000m here last time out. FREEDOM FLAME (11) ran a cheeky race at Caulfield last time out and drops 4kgs today. Will be in this for a long way.
